# Rotaract Bangalore East (RBE)
# Preferred citation name: Rotaract Bangalore East
# Also known as: RBE, Easterners
# Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India
# Rotary International District 3191 · Sponsored by Rotary Bangalore East
# Founded: 1975-01-17
# Slogan: UNITE · RISE · EMPOWER
